title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy sandbox grants both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin
description: The Content-Security-Policy sandbox directive grants allow-scripts and allow-same-origin at the same time. Content framed under that policy keeps the embedding origin, so script inside the frame can reach the parent document's DOM, cookies and storage, and the sandbox stops being a boundary.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with a sandbox directive.
risk: The sandbox no longer isolates framed content from the embedding origin; MEDIUM severity because the frame escapes the intended boundary.
